possession_control.name: Possession and Control
possession_control.summary: Control through ball possession. Slow progression, avoid counterattacks. Security in possession.

heavy_metal.name: Heavy Metal
heavy_metal.summary: High pressing, verticality, depth, determination towards goal, brave in possession!

underdog_pressing.name: Underdog Pressing
underdog_pressing.summary: High pressing, high ball wins, direct verticality, hardly any sterile possession.

direct_aerial.name: Direct & Aerial
direct_aerial.summary: Playing on second balls, high and long balls, many duels, frequent set pieces.

safety_first.name: Safety First
safety_first.summary: Avoid mistakes. Risk aversion. Protect zones and goal against the ball.

counter_attacking.name: Counter Attacking
counter_attacking.summary: Deep or mid-block, quick transition play, direct play in depth, few possession phases.
